output.headline: Provider specialist with an open platform in the sub-sector, six Midwest deals and a median deal of $172M, close to the target's size.
output.differentiator: Second-most adjacent provider deals on the list (15, behind Nordic Capital's 18), level with GTCR at six Midwest deals, and a median deal of $172M near the target's size. [T:record]
output.why_them: Add-on to open platform; Midwest provider specialist paying upper-quartile prices

acquirer_overview.title: A provider-focused sponsor with a closed record and fresh capital
points: Financial sponsor with 23 deals from 2017 to 2023; 18 closed (78%) [T:record, K:closed_share].
Provider specialist: 16 of 23 deals are in provider services, and it has an open platform in the target's sub-sector [A:angles].
Capacity: a 2023 headline reports its largest private equity fund to date at over $5 Billion [P:2].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: An add-on to an open platform, backed by a deep provider record
points: The open platform makes the target an add-on. Deals in this or neighbouring sub-sectors are a modest factor in its likelihood [A:angles, S:sector_rel].
Cross-sell is a distinctive motive: 8 of 23 deals, against 21% of all deals in the file [M:cross_sell].
Six Midwest deals, including Jefferson Ambulatory Care ($75M, 2021) in the target's own sub-sector [T:record, D:MA-2021-0083].

precedent_activity.title: Midwest and mid-size precedents, priced well above the comparable median
points: Jefferson Ambulatory Care: $75M management buyout, 2021, Midwest, 17.8x, closed [D:MA-2021-0083].
Clearwater Mental Health: $398M recapitalization, 2023, Midwest, 16.8x, withdrawn [D:MA-2023-0166].
Woodland PACE: $204M management buyout, 2021, 17.6x, closed. 9 of 23 deals sit in the $100M-$400M size band [D:MA-2021-0025, K:size_band].

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible; the bid leans on the platform exit
points: Across 70 comparable deals the range is 10.7x to 15.3x, median 12.8x. The target's 16.8% margin beats the 12.9% comp median, supporting the 75th percentile [V:comps].
Its own median paid is 16.2x, above the 15.3x upper quartile of comparable deals [V:comps, T:record].
With 5.0x leverage and a $128M equity cheque, maximum price is $193M at the same exit and $216M at a 15.0x platform exit [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target [V:lbo].
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M [V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: The bid works only if it underwrites the add-on exit; same-exit maximum is $193M [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Completion record
risk_flags.concern: 18 of 23 deals closed (78%); share closed is a slight factor against [K:closed_share, S:close_rate_s].
risk_flags.mitigant: Both Midwest-relevant control precedents, Jefferson and Woodland PACE, closed [D:MA-2021-0083, D:MA-2021-0025].
risk_flags.reality: Clearwater Mental Health ($398M, 2023) was withdrawn, so certainty of close should be tested [D:MA-2023-0166].

risk_flags.title: Competitive process
risk_flags.concern: Nordic Capital has 4 same-sub-sector deals and an open platform; GTCR also has six Midwest deals [T:record].
risk_flags.mitigant: Welsh Carson's open platform and 15 adjacent provider deals give a credible add-on case [A:angles, T:record].
risk_flags.reality: Only 1 own-sub-sector deal, and Platform Build is tagged on 1 of 23 deals [M:platform_build].

conviction.rationale: High because it has 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 15 in adjacent provider sub-sectors, plus an open platform in the sub-sector, which gives an add-on route [C:conviction, A:angles].
